  2. A certificate issued by hand expired

    It was not in the renewal job's list, and its expiry warning went to a mailbox no one reads.

    1. 10:42
      The certificate expires
    2. 10:58
      Cause found
    3. 11:29

  3. What changes in the certificate inventory and alerts.yaml

  4. Three actions, one done

    1. Send expiry warnings to the on-call rota
    2. Put every certificate under the renewal job
    3. Alert 14 days before any certificate expires
